body: A family of language models trained for code generation and completion.
plain_description: **Help your team write, complete, and fill in code across many programming languages.** Choose from model sizes ranging from 1B to 33B. Fine-tune models for downstream tasks.
technical_description: DeepSeek Coder is a family of code language models trained on code and natural language. Models support project-level code completion and infilling, chat inference, and fine-tuning. The README demonstrates use with Transformers and vLLM, and describes converting models to GGUF or using GPTQ with ExLlamaV2.
title: DeepSeek Coder
